apiName.title: Api Name
apiName.description: What kind of operation to perform

methodName.title: Method Name
methodName.description: What sub operation to use for the selected operation

as2From.title: As2 From
as2From.description: The value of the AS2From header of AS2 message.

as2MessageStructure.title: As2 Message Structure
as2MessageStructure.description: The structure of AS2 Message. One of: PLAIN - No encryption, no signature, SIGNED - No encryption, signature, ENCRYPTED - Encryption, no signature, ENCRYPTED_SIGNED - Encryption, signature

as2To.title: As2 To
as2To.description: The value of the AS2To header of AS2 message.

as2Version.title: As2 Version
as2Version.description: The version of the AS2 protocol.

asyncMdnPortNumber.title: Async Mdn Port Number
asyncMdnPortNumber.description: The port number of asynchronous MDN server.

attachedFileName.title: Attached File Name
attachedFileName.description: The name of the attached file

clientFqdn.title: Client Fqdn
clientFqdn.description: The Client Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN). Used in message ids sent by endpoint.

compressionAlgorithm.title: Compression Algorithm
compressionAlgorithm.description: The algorithm used to compress EDI message.

dispositionNotificationTo.title: Disposition Notification To
dispositionNotificationTo.description: The value of the Disposition-Notification-To header. Assigning a value to this parameter requests a message disposition notification (MDN) for the AS2 message.

ediMessageCharset.title: Edi Message Charset
ediMessageCharset.description: The charset of the content type of EDI message.

ediMessageTransferEncoding.title: Edi Message Transfer Encoding
ediMessageTransferEncoding.description: The transfer encoding of EDI message.

ediMessageType.title: Edi Message Type
ediMessageType.description: The content type of EDI message. One of application/edifact, application/edi-x12, application/edi-consent, application/xml

from.title: From
from.description: The value of the From header of AS2 message.

httpConnectionPoolSize.title: Http Connection Pool Size
httpConnectionPoolSize.description: The maximum size of the connection pool for http connections (client only)

httpConnectionPoolTtl.title: Http Connection Pool Ttl
httpConnectionPoolTtl.description: The time to live for connections in the connection pool (client only)

httpConnectionTimeout.title: Http Connection Timeout
httpConnectionTimeout.description: The timeout of the http connection (client only)

httpSocketTimeout.title: Http Socket Timeout
httpSocketTimeout.description: The timeout of the underlying http socket (client only)

inBody.title: In Body
inBody.description: Sets the name of a parameter to be passed in the exchange In Body

mdnMessageTemplate.title: Mdn Message Template
mdnMessageTemplate.description: The template used to format MDN message

receiptDeliveryOption.title: Receipt Delivery Option
receiptDeliveryOption.description: The return URL that the message receiver should send an asynchronous MDN to. If not present the receipt is synchronous. (Client only)

requestUri.title: Request Uri
requestUri.description: The request URI of EDI message.

server.title: Server
server.description: The value included in the Server message header identifying the AS2 Server.

serverFqdn.title: Server Fqdn
serverFqdn.description: The Server Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN). Used in message ids sent by endpoint.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: The value of Subject header of AS2 message.

targetHostname.title: Target Hostname
targetHostname.description: The host name (IP or DNS name) of target host.

targetPortNumber.title: Target Port Number
targetPortNumber.description: The port number of target host. -1 indicates the scheme default port.

userAgent.title: User Agent
userAgent.description: The value included in the User-Agent message header identifying the AS2 user agent.

exceptionHandler.title: Exception Handler
exceptionHandler.description: To let the consumer use a custom ExceptionHandler. Notice if the option bridgeErrorHandler is enabled then this option is not in use. By default the consumer will deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

exchangePattern.title: Exchange Pattern
exchangePattern.description: Sets the exchange pattern when the consumer creates an exchange.

expectContinue.title: Expect Continue
expectContinue.description: Controls whether the Expect: 100-Continue header is included in outbound AS2 messages. When enabled, the client sends the headers first and waits for a 100 Continue response from the server before sending the message body. This can improve efficiency with compatible partners but may cause 3-second delays with servers that don't support the protocol. Default is false for backward compatibility.

lazyStartProducer.title: Lazy Start Producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

accessToken.title: Access Token
accessToken.description: The access token that is used by the client for bearer authentication.

decryptingPrivateKey.title: Decrypting Private Key
decryptingPrivateKey.description: The key used to encrypt the EDI message.

encryptingAlgorithm.title: Encrypting Algorithm
encryptingAlgorithm.description: The algorithm used to encrypt EDI message.

encryptingCertificateChain.title: Encrypting Certificate Chain
encryptingCertificateChain.description: The chain of certificates used to encrypt EDI message.

hostnameVerifier.title: Hostname Verifier
hostnameVerifier.description: Set hostname verifier for SSL session.

mdnAccessToken.title: Mdn Access Token
mdnAccessToken.description: The access token that is used by the server when it sends an async MDN.

mdnPassword.title: Mdn Password
mdnPassword.description: The password that is used by the server for basic authentication when it sends an async MDN.

mdnUserName.title: Mdn User Name
mdnUserName.description: The user-name that is used by the server for basic authentication when it sends an async MDN. If options for basic authentication and bearer authentication are both set then basic authentication takes precedence.

password.title: Password
password.description: The password that is used by the client for basic authentication.

signedReceiptMicAlgorithms.title: Signed Receipt Mic Algorithms
signedReceiptMicAlgorithms.description: The list of algorithms, in order of preference, requested to generate a message integrity check (MIC) returned in message disposition notification (MDN). Multiple algorithms can be separated by comma.

signingAlgorithm.title: Signing Algorithm
signingAlgorithm.description: The algorithm used to sign EDI message.

signingCertificateChain.title: Signing Certificate Chain
signingCertificateChain.description: The chain of certificates used to sign EDI message.

signingPrivateKey.title: Signing Private Key
signingPrivateKey.description: The key used to sign the EDI message.

sslContext.title: Ssl Context
sslContext.description: Set SSL context for connection to remote server.

userName.title: User Name
userName.description: The user-name that is used by the client for basic authentication. If options for basic authentication and bearer authentication are both set then basic authentication takes precedence.

validateSigningCertificateChain.title: Validate Signing Certificate Chain
validateSigningCertificateChain.description: Certificates to validate the message's signature against. If not supplied, validation will not take place. Server: validates the received message. Client: not yet implemented, should validate the MDN
